method: Independent visible-only ordinary browser play at default driver settings. Read driver --help, own screenshots and displayed UI only; no implementation or other reports. Exactly two terminal attempts. Software WebGL fallback; synthetic paused screenshot play limits real-time feel and performance judgment.

gameplay.reason: Critical optic kill is satisfying and recoveries replenish resources; phase evade adds a useful tactical verb. My attempts became navigation-and-exposure struggles, with limited successful combat beyond the initial guard. Two deaths felt punishing before the mission loop developed.

presentation.reason: Strong rain, wet surfaces, cyan/amber identity, title typography and large relay landmark. Blocky robots, repeated slabs and sparse scene dressing still read as a stylized prototype rather than a finished premium shooter.

usability.reason: Visible keys, paused map, fresh-start button and exact outside-reach prompts help. First friction was movement blocked on slabs or wall edges without an obvious readable route from my current view. Failed E holds under fire cost substantial health.

readability.reason: Large vitals and ammo, objective distance and critical optic are clear. Tiny map detail and environmental labels compete with compass/threat marks. At the archive wall my screenshot was almost entirely opaque gray, while damage directions did not give me a useful visible target.

AAA readiness.reason: Coherent slice presentation and functioning terminal flow, but limited animation/material/encounter variety visible here, frustrating collision navigation, and insufficient threat clarity to approach AAA shipping expectations. This is based on early mission coverage, not unseen finale.

strengths: Immediate visual identity and attractive title screen.
Map freezes mission and clearly distinguishes low cover from walls.
Initial optic aim produces critical elimination feedback.
Mara recovery and resource restoration make the recover/combat loop legible.
Fresh-start terminal control reset time, objectives and health visibly.
first_friction: Attempt 1: after Mara, diagonal movement toward the Heart ended facing an opaque wall at 15m; continued W and attempted E made no progress while shields/health drained. Attempt 2: east-side low cover and doorway wall edges consumed repeated movement corrections.
objections: Ordinary movement near cover is hard to judge from first person; attempts to walk around edges often made no distance progress.

Recovery needs precision under fire; one attempt at 3.3m explicitly reported 0.5m outside reach, then a small correction/2.3sec hold still failed before retreat. Longer corrected hold eventually succeeded.
My aim correction toward an unseen attacker missed; damage indicators alone did not resolve target acquisition.
Header says BUILD 67 despite review assignment build68; visible version labeling should be aligned.

attempts.coverage: Deployed; used facility map; killed induction guard via aimed optic burst; reloaded; approached west archive diagonally and recovered Mara. Tried diagonal advance to Heart but met opaque wall at 15m. W and E hold failed; backward/right/forward correction also left distance unchanged; fired during escape attempt and died.

attempts.classification: fresh full-run attempt via START FRESH
attempts.coverage: Fresh reset 00:00. Killed induction guard; tried east approach, blocked by low cover. Left correction ran into doorway edge; right correction cleared it. Crossed toward Mara; first E hold was outside reach, second correction/hold failed, retreat/firing missed. Selected breacher, returned and held E longer to recover Mara. Advanced across central yard toward Heart, reached 4.4m with 1.6m outside reach prompt. Shift/left correction and E hold ended in death. No second memory or finale reached.

coverageLimits: No win, checkpoint continuation, jammer defeat, extraction or finale. Rifle, breacher selection/fire, reload, movement, ADS, map, recovery, phase dash and death/fresh start covered. No audio or real-time performance rating inferred.
actions: Driver retained all command/result evidence and screenshots in its own output directory; misses, failed holds and corrections not removed.
